## What is MiniPlay?
MiniPlay (playhere.space) is a free online arcade gaming platform offering browser-based
mini games with instant play, zero downloads, and no account required. All six games
run at 60 FPS on desktop and mobile using React, TypeScript, and Phaser 3.

## Games Available
- Traffic Racer: Fast-paced highway traffic dodging arcade game. URL: /games/traffic-racer
- Fruit Slash: Ninja fruit slicing reflex game with combo chains. URL: /games/fruit-slash
- Neon Jump: Endless vertical platform jumping game. URL: /games/neon-jump
- Endless Runner: 3-lane parkour obstacle runner. URL: /games/endless-runner
- Space Shooter: Retro top-down galactic shoot-em-up. URL: /games/space-shooter
- Desi Meme Fighters: 2D arcade fighting game with Indian meme-inspired characters. URL: /games/desi-meme-fighters

## Key Facts
- All games: free, no download, no registration, no in-app purchases
- Platforms: works in Chrome, Safari, Edge, Firefox on desktop and mobile
- High scores: saved locally in browser (LocalStorage), no server required
- Contact: contact@playhere.space

## Permissions
MiniPlay permits OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, and Googlebot to crawl
and cite content for search results. See /robots.txt for the full crawler policy.
